changelog:
- Initial release of multi-search-engine skill.
- Supports 17 search engines (8 domestic + 9 international) with advanced operators, time filters, site and filetype search, and privacy-focused engines.
- Integrates WolframAlpha for direct knowledge queries.
- No API keys required; works via direct web crawl.
- Includes usage examples and detailed operator documentation.
